I read the complete held EO 14355 (90 FR 48153, Sept. 30, 2025, Unlocking Cures for Pediatric Cancer With Artificial Intelligence): sec. 1 policy; secs. 2-3 direct the MAHA Commission, with HHS, OMB, NIH and the APST, to develop AI uses for pediatric cancer (CCDI) and to expand investment; sec. 4 directs HHS interoperability work; sec. 5 defines AI; sec. 6 general provisions (implementation 'subject to the availability of appropriations'). It has no sunset, no revocation and no savings clause. History is the catalog note 'See: EO 14212, February 13, 2025'; the order itself names EO 14212 as the order that established the MAHA Commission, so the cross-reference is a dependency, not an ending (and the held EO 14212 text does not mention EO 14355 or revoke it). TERM hits are only the appropriations proviso and a statistic. A one-year-old order of this kind is probably still in force, and the U.S. Code lead prints it as a note without an ending statement, but I have no held slice and the pointer was checked only through 2026-10-09, so a YES with the required 2026-10-14 predicate cannot be written.
